description.value:
Gecko-setae soles and palms grown off a Spiderlands climber. Climb Speed equal to your land Speed. You can hang from a ceiling or wall to keep your hands free, though not fight from there at full effect.

Rider: It clings when you panic. On a failed save against fear you are stuck fast to the nearest surface and must spend an action to peel free.

cinderfall.incomplete: Climb Speed above is set equal to current land Speed via a formula value -- real precedent: pf2e-source/packs/pf2e/equipment/divers-gloves-greater.json uses the identical @actor.system.movement.speeds.land.value reference for Swim Speed. The fear-triggered stick-fast rider has no hook: no roll option ties 'failed a fear save' to an involuntary movement restriction.
